36 words for shame & guilt

The 36 words below run from Abashed to Worthless. Its core words are Ashamed, Guilty, Embarrassed, Humiliated, and Worthless. Some are mild and some are intense, so start with the one that feels closest and read the words around it. If nothing fits, the families on either side of it on the wheel, Surprise & Shock and Relational Hurt, hold feelings that sit nearby.
